title: The Politician and the Padawan
front_description: Padmé picks up a discarded blaster and joins the arena battle. At one point she and Anakin are back-to-back, fighting off both droids and flying Geonosians. "You call this diplomacy?" Anakin asks with a grin, recalling a prior conversation. "No, I call it aggressive negotiations," she replies smartly, returning the smile. But little time to quip as more and more droids pour into the battle-rocked arena.
back_description: Erik Tiemens' breathtaking production painting depicts a super battle droid in combat.
